```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(httr)
```

## scrape table

i want the first table from [this page](https://www.samhsa.gov/data/sites/default/files/NSDUHsaeShortTermCHG2015/NSDUHsaeShortTermCHG2015.htm)

read in the html

```{r}
url = "https://www.samhsa.gov/data/sites/default/files/NSDUHsaeShortTermCHG2015/NSDUHsaeShortTermCHG2015.htm"

drug_use_html = read_html(url)
```

extract table(s); focus on first one

```{r}
table_mj =
  drug_use_html |> 
  html_element(css = "table") |> 
  html_table() |> 
  slice(-1)
```

* html_element: extract html with css tag, selects first list
* html_table: prints html into table
* slice: removes row
